verdict.rationale: Parsec for Teams provides an admin panel where organizations provision access for team members and guests. Provisioned Team Computers can be assigned to a single member or to a group, which is a per-group access mapping. Role-based admin roles and SCIM support round out centralized user management. Missing for 10: detailed docs on group structure and what per-group policy settings exist beyond computer assignment, a described machine directory/address-book view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, machines and users are organized in a shared address book or console with per-group access policies

citations.quote: Organizations can provision access to guests and team members via the admin panel or by SSO
Once a Team Computer is provisioned, it can be assigned to either a single team member or a group.
Create granular admin roles through role based access
